# Vendored libraries

`lightweight-charts-4.1.3.standalone.production.js` is
`dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js` from the npm package
`lightweight-charts@4.1.3`, unchanged. It is served by the app instead of
from a CDN, so charts work without any third-party script host.

License: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-lightweight-charts.txt`). The library asks
that its NOTICE text (`NOTICE-lightweight-charts.txt`, taken from the
library's repository at tag v4.1.3) and a link to tradingview.com appear on
the page that uses it; the dashboard footer shows both.
